options.label: Terrain Wobble
options.description: Snap full-cube terrain to the geometry grid. Clouds, entities and detailed block models keep their original shapes.

options.label: Affine Terrain Textures
options.description: Use affine mapping on full-cube terrain. Models keep perspective-correct textures.

options.label: Nearest Terrain Textures
options.description: Use unfiltered original texels on full-cube terrain. Model and cloud textures keep their original sampling.

options.label: PSX Hand Colors
options.description: Apply color reduction and dithering to held items. Geometry and texture mapping stay unchanged.

options.label: Geometry Grid
options.description: Pixel grid for terrain wobble and dithering. Display resolution is controlled separately.

options.label: Low Resolution
options.description: Resolve the world at the selected display resolution, preserving the window aspect ratio.

options.label: Low Resolution Quality
options.description: 720p by default. Keeps the current aspect ratio and never exceeds the source resolution.

options.label: 15-bit Color (RGB555)
options.description: Use 32 levels per channel after shading, matching the PS1 color format.

options.label: PS1 Dithering
options.description: Use the original signed 4 by 4 PS1 dither matrix before conversion to RGB555.
